budget_ledger.exclusions: Build/startup/storage/egress and platform scheduling overlap are ancillary; this is a running allocation estimate, not an invoice.

final_freeze_validation.controller_audit_requirement: The unchanged final worker requires every case to repeat the full controller and compare observations, actions and commands, in addition to physics/choice audit.
final_freeze_validation.limits: Offline freeze/source/provenance/selection checks only. Original terminal-call, receipt, stop and deadline gates still run at launch; no final cases or cloud calls occurred during this audit.

formulas.bootstrap: NumPy 2.3.4 default_rng(612256).integers(0,256,size=(20000,256)); resample paired map differences and report .025/.975 quantiles.
formulas.grouping: Average all three training-seed rewards within each map for single-policy groups; one member for ensembles, blends and controls; then average maps.
formulas.selection: Among only the six frozen candidates, require zero deaths/invalid calls, home rate >= greedy minus 1/256, and positive paired mean gain. Sort by descending mean reward, then group ID; choose one.

limits: Metadata, source/weights, provenance and recorded audit bindings verified. This independent audit did not download production trajectories or rerun physics/controller simulations.
Confirmation selects among six groups. Its intervals do not correct for winner selection and do not establish final improvement.
Final worlds remain untouched by this audit. Primary success requires the separately frozen final evaluation and unchanged 1-percentage-point/interval/safety gate. Reference promotion is separate.
The map bootstrap is conditional on fixed learned training seeds; it does not estimate variation from retraining models.
